analysis.transcript: Sure. First, move closer to your router and make sure the cables are snug. Next, restart your router and modem by unplugging them for 30 seconds, then plug them back in. After that, restart your device. Then check for any system updates on your device and install them. Next, forget the Wi-Fi network on your device, then reconnect by re-entering the password. Finally, make sure no one's streaming heavily on your network, and if it still drops, try changing the Wi-Fi channel in the router settings. That usually clears it up.
